localizedSurfaces: homepage (every section, including the interactive demos)
title, meta description, Open Graph and Twitter text
JSON-LD (SoftwareApplication, MobileApplication, Organization, FAQPage, WebPage, ItemList, BreadcrumbList, Course)
hreflang (en, es, fr, de, it, pt-BR, zh-Hans, x-default) and self-canonical per locale
generation: es.html, fr.html, de.html, it.html, pt-br.html and zh-hans.html are generated from index.html and blog-engine/i18n/home.json by blog-engine/build-i18n.mjs

detection.persistence: localStorage key iro_locale_choice records an explicit choice from the language menu or the suggestion bar; / sends a returning visitor with a saved choice to that locale, and choosing English saves "en", which keeps / in English. Dismissing the suggestion is remembered for 30 days.
detection.note: Any Portuguese browser language (pt, pt-BR, pt-PT) is offered the Brazilian Portuguese page, the only Portuguese version. Simplified Chinese browser languages (zh-CN, zh-SG, zh-Hans, plain zh) are offered the zh-hans page; Traditional Chinese ones (zh-TW, zh-HK, zh-MO, zh-Hant) are not.
